meta.notes: Abstractive summaries: b 'regular batteries', c 'kinetic battery', d 'not contain a kinetic battery'. The reason in meeting d is stated only briefly (B11, as a question); the detailed cost overrun in meeting d (16.8 against a 12.5 Euro target) comes later and concerns the whole design.

topic: how the remote control is powered

options.B: kinetic power with a backup battery

versions.option_text: kinetic power with a backup battery

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager raises the power question and asks whether to add a charging unit or simply run on regular batteries.

chain.speaker: ID
chain.gist: The Industrial Designer argues that a rechargeable design adds complexity, cost and a docking cradle, and that users are used to buying batteries.

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager settles on sticking to regular batteries.

chain.speaker: ID
chain.gist: The Industrial Designer suggests a battery plus something else, finding the kinetic option the most interesting because people like to fiddle with it and it is a sales gimmick.
chain.option: kinetic power with a backup battery

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager brings the power question back and says he likes kinetic power with a battery as backup.

chain.speaker: ME
chain.gist: The Marketing Expert warns that kinetic power commits the user to moving the remote, and that a device left unused, for example during a holiday, runs down.
chain.option: kinetic power with a backup battery

chain.speaker: ME
chain.gist: The Marketing Expert notes that people who wear kinetic watches all the time find them always powered, with no battery to change.
chain.option: kinetic power with a backup battery

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager concludes that the battery would keep the kinetic remote ticking over when it is not moved, adopting kinetic power with a backup battery.
chain.option: kinetic power with a backup battery

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager opens the price sheet to see whether anything in the design has to be rethought.
chain.option: kinetic power with a backup battery

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager confirms that the remote has a battery but no kinetic power: just battery.

chain.speaker: PM
chain.gist: The Project Manager gives cost constraints as the reason for dropping kinetic power, phrased as a question to the team.
